purpose: Propose traceability presentation for the release report.
scope: Design review only. No actual release was assessed.

critical_conclusion.text: Keep mapping, conformance, and passing execution separate.
critical_conclusion.consequence: One coverage score can hide failures and unsupported conclusions.
critical_conclusion.next_action: Review the proposed summary and three coverage matrices.

user_source.instruction: Combine release confidence, decisions, code review, and requirement-to-test traceability in the report.

confidence.basis: The shared coverage procedure, traceability template, and runtime guide agree.
confidence.limit: This review defines presentation semantics. It does not establish available release data or verified behavior.

proposed_first_screen.placement: Show coverage gaps beside the release recommendation and failed checks.
indicators: Meaningful changes with matching passing execution
proposed_first_screen.display_rule: Show qualified and total counts. Link each indicator to its complete matrix.
proposed_first_screen.gap_rule: Show the reason, affected behavior, consequence, owner, next action, and evidence.
proposed_first_screen.limit: Gap order guides attention. It does not define release policy or automatic blocking thresholds.

counting_rules: Do not derive denominators from mapped rows.
Count each inventory item once across many-to-many relationships.
Qualify a compound AC only when all applicable predicates qualify.
Use N/A for a known empty denominator.
Use UNKNOWN when the complete inventory is unavailable.
Neither N/A nor UNKNOWN establishes successful coverage.
Keep instrumented line and branch coverage separate.
Keep unit, contract, integration, system, and E2E boundaries visible.
Interpret TC >= AC = Code Change as behavior containment and equivalence.

matrices.name: AC to Test Case
matrices.inventory: Every applicable requirement or defect AC, including unmapped ACs.
columns: Requirement or defect and source-qualified AC version
Canonical case and required test level
Inspected assertion and exact test revision or hash

matrices.name: AC to Code Change
matrices.inventory: Every applicable AC, including necessary unchanged implementation.
columns: Requirement or defect and source-qualified AC version
Exact base and head source locations
Missing, extra, contradictory, or unknown behavior

matrices.name: Code Change to Test Case
matrices.inventory: Every meaningful implementation change, including untraced changes.
columns: Change ID, repository, and full base and head commits
Canonical case and required test level
Direct inspected setup, invocation, and assertion chain

selected_row_drilldown.purpose: Navigate the evidence for the selected relationship.
limits: The chain does not prove coverage or one-to-one relationships.
Shared AC membership does not establish direct change-to-test coverage.
Show each source, assertion, and execution link separately.

semantic_states.UNCHANGED: Necessary existing implementation satisfies an AC without a new code change.
semantic_states.UNKNOWN: Evidence cannot establish the relationship or inspected behavior.
semantic_states.CONTRADICTORY: Inspected behavior violates the intended predicate.
semantic_states.EXTRA: Demonstrated business behavior lacks support after an intent search.
semantic_states.MATCH: Inspected behavior matches the intended predicate within the declared evidence scope.
classification_rules: An absent mapping alone remains UNKNOWN.
Classify supporting maintenance and test-only changes separately.
Keep maintenance rationale and proportionate checks visible.
Mapping can be complete while conformance or execution fails.
A passing command does not establish intended behavior.
Expected-failure assertions do not establish passing intended behavior.
Unit execution cannot close required integration or system gaps.

existing_metrics.behavior_to_code: Current CONFIRMED implementation links. Source meaning remains a review responsibility.
existing_metrics.behavior_to_test: Current CONFIRMED assertion links. Required test levels remain a review responsibility.
existing_metrics.current_source_execution: Declared source freshness and assertion binding availability. Failed or simulated results can qualify.

presentation_rules: Label the proposed matrices as reviewed assessment data until their producers exist.
Do not rename current_source_execution as passing behavior coverage.
Do not infer business verification from VALID or CURRENT.
Keep retained result declarations and DECLARED assertion bindings visible.
Every current runtime business verification field remains NOT_VERIFIED.
Keep human recommendation and deployment authorization separate.

locators.supports: Evidence identity fields and relationship grades.
Inventories, three matrices, metrics, and counting rules.
Behavior equivalence, conformance states, and test-level limits.
Inventory declarations and separate summary metrics.
Relationship evidence, three matrices, execution, and actionable gaps.
Contract status, freshness, declarations, and runtime limits.
Implemented metric meanings and execution limits.
Three required views and semantic conformance limits.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
